hook_text: Slide, flip, turn: three moves that never change a shape's size.
clip_script: A translation slides every point of a figure the same distance in the same direction. A reflection flips a figure over a mirror line; the image is reversed, like your reflection in a mirror. A rotation turns a figure about a fixed point through a given angle, in a given direction. Translations, reflections and rotations do not change the shape or size of the figure, so the image is always congruent to the object.
visual_style: A flag on a grid slides five right, flips in a dashed mirror line, then spins a quarter turn around a pin; a congruent tick follows each move.
pacing: Three quick moves with labels, then the congruent reveal.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to perform each transformation on squared paper.
